name: Lanternvine Tangle
introDiscord:
Lanternvines knot themselves through the forest ahead, glowing softly
as they curl around roots, shrines, stones, and anything else that stays
still too long. Lanternvine Crabs patrol beneath them wearing stolen
lights like tiny ceremonial armor.
introTwitch:
Lanternvines knot themselves through the forest ahead, glowing softly
as they curl around roots, shrines, stones, and anything else that stays
still too long. Lanternvine Crabs patrol beneath them wearing stolen
lights like tiny ceremonial armor.

lanternvine-tangle-approach.prompt:
Three paths disappear beneath loops of glowing vine. Several tendrils
slowly reach toward your belongings with suspicious interest.

left.message:
A cluster of lanternvines has grown around an old offering basket.
Peeling them back reveals Star Candies—and causes three vines to
immediately begin growing back over it.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool sits beneath a root where Shizuki tied every loose
strap on her bag into an enormous knot.

Her note reads:

'Vines learned buckles.

This is a serious escalation.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool untouched. You're already healthy, and
your buckles currently remain your own business.

forward.message:
A Lanternvine Crab shuffles into the route wearing six glowing tendrils
like a crown.

One vine reaches for your bag.

The Crab raises both claws as if this theft is somehow official.

lanternvine-tangle-depths.prompt:
The Tangle tightens into a maze of living knots. Three routes remain
open mostly because the vines haven't finished closing them yet.

left.message:
A Lanternvine Crab is carefully arranging glowing vines around its
shell.

You brush one.

The Crab freezes.

You have apparently touched the outfit.

right.message:
One Berry dangles from a vine beside Shizuki's note:

'Vine stole Berry.

I stole Berry back.

Vine stole glove.

Negotiations ongoing.'

forward.message:
A shrine coffer sits inside a luminous root knot. The vines politely
unwrap themselves just enough for you to claim the Star Candies.

That was suspiciously cooperative.

lanternvine-tangle-threshold.prompt:
The lanternvines converge into an enormous glowing knot around three
final passages. Crab tracks cover every root.

left.message:
An offering basket has become completely woven into the roots. Inside
are Star Candies and one button.

Shizuki may have lost the negotiations.

right.message:
A Lanternvine Crab lowers itself from the vines upside down.

It appears very pleased with this entrance.

You admit nothing.

forward.message:
Restorative sap sits inside a folded leaf with Shizuki's warning:

'Drink first.

Untangle yourself second.

Trying both simultaneously caused incident.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the sap untouched. At full health, you can devote your full
attention to not becoming part of the landscaping.

boss-antechamber.name: Luminous Root Knot
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every lanternvine in the chamber begins tightening toward one enormous
root knot. Smaller Crabs hurriedly abandon their decorations.

bossPromptDiscord:
The vines pull apart just enough to reveal two enormous claws hidden
inside the Luminous Root Knot.

Every stolen lantern flares at once.

Something has apparently been collecting the brightest vines for a very
long time.

Use /yes to approach the Luminous Root Knot or /no to let the local
gardener keep its decorations.
bossPromptTwitch:
The vines pull apart just enough to reveal two enormous claws hidden
inside the Luminous Root Knot.

Every stolen lantern flares at once.

Something has apparently been collecting the brightest vines for a very
long time.

Use !yes to approach the Luminous Root Knot or !no to let the local
gardener keep its decorations.
bossRetreatText:
You back away from the glowing knot. The vines slowly close again,
hiding the enormous claws inside.

boss.revealText:
The root knot tears apart as a massive lantern-covered Crab emerges.

Glowroot Clawlord reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Glowroot Clawlord retreats beneath the roots.

The ordinary Crabs immediately begin collecting the loose lanternvines
from the battlefield.

Fashion never rests."
